description: Enumerate a puppetsync session's open PRs from the GitHub API by head branch (and author). The PRs are the ground truth for the approve/merge plans — no inventory snapshot needed.

head_branch.description: The session's feature branch (the PRs' head branch)

author.description: Only PRs submitted by this user (the session's pr_user)

prs.description: PR records to use instead of querying the API (for testing)
